messages.subject: Extract test values
parts:
Hello!
First, thank you for a great package!
My question is whether it is possible to show or extract test results. What I would be interested in would be, beside the table I export to have a table showing for each variable in the table:
Test performed - Test value - DF (if applicable) - p value
Is there a way to extract this information or to show it?
Stef

messages.author: 176185748932f5c0
messages.subject: Re: Extract test values
parts:
Hi,

By now it is not possible to excract que values of the test in detail (statistic, degrees of freedom), but only the p-value. However, in the paper published in JSS (see compareGroups citation) there is described all methods used dependign on the type of variable and groups.

Regards, and thanks for using the compareGroups package.

Isaac.
